main.description: A bar or restaurant claiming itself. Held at rkey `self` in the venue's own repo, so possession of the record IS the claim — no approval step and no registry. A venue whose handle is its domain (deathandco.com) is verified by the protocol itself. Publishing this is what retroactively links every patron sighting already pointing at that domain.

currentMenu.description: The menu record to treat as current. Menus are immutable, so this pointer is how a venue says which one is live.

publication.description: Pointer to the venue's site.standard.publication record (rkey `self`), connecting the venue to its Standard.site web presence.
